subject: Acme Corp - Renewal & expansion recap (usage review + next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Acme renewal/expansion kickoff — usage review & next steps

Thanks for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our side so we’re aligned on goals, pain, and next steps.

Attendees: Jordan (Acme), Priya (Acme), Marissa (Redwood), Rachel (Redwood - CSM)

High-level goals we heard:
- Reduce per-call latency spikes for interactive search features (SLO: 100ms p95)
- Lower per-token cost for high-volume embedding pipelines (search + rerank)
- Standardize on a predictable serving plan ahead of your May renewal

Primary pain points / constraints:
1) Latency spikes during peak queries (primarily evening PST) — current public endpoint is inconsistent
2) Cost volatility when batch jobs run against embeddings — the team is sensitive to cost overruns
3) Security/compliance: procurement will require SOC 2 evidence and contract language for data handling

Potential path we discussed:
- Short pilot on Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) for embeddings workload (2–4 GPU nodes)
- Usage review & performance baseline (we’ll provide a pilot config + expected perf numbers)
- Commercial proposal for annual reserved capacity, with a phased rollout to production if pilot meets KPIs

Timeline notes:
- Your renewal window is May; you indicated a preference to decide by end of March if the pilot looks good
- Technical kickoff for pilot: target week of Feb 8

Immediate next steps (owner / ETA):
- Marissa (me): send usage export & initial proposal by EOD Friday (attached: usage CSV)
- Jordan: confirm legal/procurement contacts and any required PO process (reply here) — Jordan said procurement@acme.com
- Rachel: schedule CSM onboarding & technical kickoff after proposal accepted

Attachments: 20270120-acme-usage-report.csv (usage export we discussed)

If I missed anything or your summary differs, please reply with edits. Happy to hop on a short follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa — that matches my notes. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- Pilot scope: prefer Dedicated for embeddings (as discussed). For initial sizing we can start with 2 nodes and scale if throughput looks good.
- Procurement: procurement@acme.com is the right inbox. Our procurement lead is Priya Shah (cc’d). They will want a SOC 2 report and the Master Services Agreement redlines.
- Timeline: agree to target a decision by late March, with technical kickoff in early Feb.

Action items for Redwood: can you include a per-month and per-token cost breakdown for the pilot vs hosted API in the proposal? Also show expected p95 latency numbers for the Dedicated config.

We’re generally positive on the Dedicated route if we can get predictable latency and a clear cost delta vs current spend. Look forward to the proposal.

—Jordan

Includes line-item per-token estimates for the two workload types and an expected latency p95 for the proposed Dedicated setup.
- SOC2-evidence.zip: SOC 2 Type II summary + auditor letter + high-level controls documentation (sensitive file — please share only with procurement/legal).
- Related links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/23456), DocuSign envelope (https://www.docusign.com/ACME-2027-REN-42)

Quick answers to Jordan’s asks:
- Per-token comparison: see page 3 of the proposal — pilot Dedicated reduces per-embedding unit cost by ~25% vs hosted at your current scale (assumes batching and KV cache).
- Latency: Dedicated config with pinned nodes shows expected p95 ~60–80ms for the interactive search pattern you described; we’ll validate during pilot.

Proposed next dates:
- Technical kickoff (pilot): Feb 9 or Feb 10 — 60–90 minute session with your infra + our infra/ops (Rachel to schedule)
- Commercial: we’ll prepare a DocuSign for signature once you confirm procurement/legal review timeframe

Attachments: 20270122-acme-proposal.pdf, SOC2-evidence.zip

Let me know which kickoff date works and if procurement needs any additional doc types.
